author: packs
description: Sales dashboards (D28-T1): the report queries the pipeline, forecast, activities and win/loss dashboard pages chart.
name: sales-dashboard-queries

definition.name: Sales: Weighted Pipeline by Close Month
definition.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', close_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS close_month, SUM(amount * COALESCE(probability, 0) / 100) AS weighted_pipeline, SUM(amount) AS pipeline FROM opportunity WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND close_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

target.query: Sales: Weighted Pipeline by Close Month

definition.name: Sales: Forecast by Category
definition.sql: SELECT COALESCE(k.name, 'Uncategorised') AS category, SUM(COALESCE(c.adjusted_amount, c.pipeline_amount, 0)) AS forecast, SUM(COALESCE(c.quota, 0)) AS quota FROM forecast_cell c JOIN forecast_period p ON p.id = c.period_ref LEFT JOIN forecast_category k ON k.id = c.category_ref WHERE (c.is_active IS NULL OR c.is_active = true) AND p.status = 'open' GROUP BY k.name, k.rank ORDER BY k.rank NULLS LAST, k.name

definition.name: Sales: Activities per Day
definition.sql: SELECT activity_date::date::text AS day, COUNT(*)::bigint AS activities FROM activity WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND activity_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

definition.name: Sales: Win Rate Percent by Quarter
definition.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('quarter', close_date), 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS quarter, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'closed_won') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS win_rate_percent FROM opportunity WHERE stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND close_date IS NOT NULL AND (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

target.query: Sales: Win Rate Percent by Quarter

title: Pack: sales dashboard queries
